text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is a technology that allows machines to think and learn like humans. One important part of AI is machine learning. This means computers can learn from data and improve over time without being told exactly what to do. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large neural networks. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. For example, it helps us unlock phones with our faces, suggests movies we might enjoy, and powers chatbots that answer our questions. AI is changing the way we live and work, and it will continue to grow in the future.
